name: Drives
author: AR Singh
description: All drives in the Omarchy bar: a single icon opens a popup with every disk, mounted or not — click unmounted to mount, click mounted to open, press 't' to open in terminal, click ✕ button to unmount, ⏏ to eject (power-off) removable drives.

barWidget.description: All attached drives with one-click mount, open, terminal, and eject
